svg.title: Paths of alpha particles passing a single gold nucleus, drawn as a small positive dot. Alpha particles arrive from the left along parallel straight lines. Those aimed far above or below the nucleus carry on almost straight, bent away by only a few degrees. Those aimed closer are pushed further away and leave at larger angles. One aimed very close is turned through about 100 degrees, and one aimed almost straight at the nucleus is turned back to the left, through about 150 degrees. Every path bends away from the nucleus, never towards it. Not to scale.

g.text: alpha particles in from the left
